title: Loaded
description: What the settings file or program gives.

always_frame.description: Border, gap and radius also on a pane alone in its tree, and on the treeview

browser.description: Program started by Super+N; `None`: `$BROWSER`, else the first installed of a list

font_size.description: Text height in px (Sonamu's own UI isn't scaled)

gap.description: Between panes and around them, in px

keybinds.description: Global shortcuts that run a shell command

pdf_viewer.description: Program the file manager opens PDFs in; `None`: the first installed of zathura, okular, evince

restore_programs.description: Programs restored running in their terminal (see `.claude/SESSIONS.md`)

startup.description: Shell commands run once when Sonamu starts (eg `dms run`)

terminal.description: Program started by Super+T; `None`: `$TERMINAL`, else the first installed of a list

watch.description: Extra files to watch for changes, eg the ones the program reads.

focused.description: Focus is inside the pane's applet (keys go to it); also its treeview marker

Key.description: A character (case-insensitive), or an evdev code for keys without one (eg 115 is volume up)

Keybind.description: Runs `command` with `sh -c` when `key` is pressed with exactly `mods` held.

accent.description: Focus on a node itself (traversal keys move it): its border and treeview marker

bg.description: Unused for now: behind the panes is the background layer (eg a wallpaper)

fg.description: Text of the treeview and projects

inactive.description: Text of inactive (eg hibernated) nodes in the treeview

RestoreProgram.description:
A program (matched by its name) restored running in its terminal: with its saved args,
or with these instead (eg `claude` with `--continue`)

SwipeSettings.description: 3 finger touchpad swipes between nodes (#141): left / right between siblings, up / down between parent and child

damping_ratio.description: Of that spring: 1 is critically damped (no bounce), below 1 overshoots and bounces, above 1 is sluggish

distance_x.description: How far the fingers move left / right to go one node, in px

distance_y.description: How far the fingers move up / down to go one node, in px

rubber_band.description: How far past the first / last node it stretches at most, in nodes

stiffness.description: Of the spring settling on a node after the fingers lift (mass 1): higher is faster

TreeviewFloating.description: Where an unpinned treeview floats over the panes, which keep their size

TreeviewSettings.description: Whether the treeview is pinned is part of the session, toggled by its pin button

floating.description: Where an unpinned one floats (only while focus is on a node)

floating_size.description: A `Center` floating one's width and height, in percent of the window's

side.description: The side a pinned one is on

width.description: The side column's width, in percent of the window's

TreeviewSide.description: A column beside the panes, which get the rest of the width
